name: io.github.brntech/myotp
title: MyOTP.App
description: Send and verify one-time passcodes over SMS, WhatsApp and Telegram.

environmentVariables.name: MYOTP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: MyOTP.App API key. Get one free at https://myotp.app/sign-up/ (15 trial credits, no card).

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: MyOTP.App API key, sent per request so the hosted server never stores it. Note: calls reach the MyOTP API from 108.61.176.199, so add that IP to your key's allowlist or every call returns 403.
